content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia
+385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun store. I have worked in butchery since completing my vocational butcher training in 2015, combining carcass preparation and fresh sausage production with customer service at the counter.

In my current role at Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat, and make fresh sausages. I also rotate cold-room stock using FIFO and record temperature checks twice daily. Alongside this work, I serve customers and advise them on cuts and cooking times—experience that fits FreshCart’s focus on knowledgeable, helpful service and honest product advice.

I hold a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024, and take care to follow hygiene and cleaning routines. I have also trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my practical butchery skills, reliability and customer-focused approach to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would be pleased to discuss my experience further.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, professional, and well tailored to the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant role. It clearly presents the candidate’s relevant butchery, fresh sausage, FIFO, temperature-checking, customer-service, HACCP, and apprentice-training experience. The examples are credible and consistent with the original candidate information. The tone appropriately reflects FreshCart’s priorities of knowledgeable customer advice, hygiene, reliability, and helpful service. It could be slightly stronger by stating the completed butcher qualification and total years of experience more explicitly.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter uses a simple, ATS-friendly structure with standard paragraphs, readable contact details, and relevant terms including butcher, carcass preparation, fresh sausage production, FIFO, temperature checks, HACCP, customer service, cuts, and cooking times. It contains no problematic tables, graphics, columns, or unusual formatting. ATS and AI screening probability is high for the stated must-have requirements because the letter clearly supports butcher training, meat-counter experience, and HACCP knowledge. Keyword coverage could be improved slightly by using the job description’s exact phrases such as “cut, portion and package fresh meat” and “service counter,” where truthful. The candidate should not be presented as having forklift experience or supermarket self-service packaging experience.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document shows a strong match for the role. It demonstrates completed butcher training, substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, HACCP knowledge, cutting and portioning, fresh sausage production, FIFO stock rotation, temperature checks, customer advice, and hygiene routines. It also reflects FreshCart’s culture through references to knowledgeable service, honest advice, reliability, and cleaning standards. The forklift licence is a candidate gap, but it is only a nice-to-have and does not represent a document defect. The letter does not claim unsupported supermarket, tray-sealer, labelling-scale, or self-service-shelf experience, which is appropriate.
critique.improvement_instructions:
Minor enhancement — In the opening paragraph, change “I have worked in butchery since completing my vocational butcher training in 2015” to “I completed my vocational butcher training in 2015 and have nine years of experience in high-street, market, and family-shop butchery.” This makes the must-have qualification and experience threshold immediately visible to both recruiters and screening systems.

Minor enhancement — In the second paragraph, change “I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat, and make fresh sausages” to “I break down beef, pork and lamb, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter, and make fresh sausages.” This uses the job advertisement’s terminology while remaining fully supported by the candidate’s original information.

Minor enhancement — In the third paragraph, change “I hold a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024” to “I hold a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024, and record cold-room and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.” This places the HACCP keyword and the associated food-safety evidence together more prominently.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter
